# AI Edge Quantizer - Experimental

> [!CAUTION]
> **EXPERIMENTAL ONLY**
>
> Files and packages contained in this directory are experimental and intended
for active research, prototyping, and internal experimentation only. Features
and interfaces in this directory are subject to change or removal without notice
and are NOT intended for stable production use.

## Overview

This directory contains experimental tools, recipe exploration workflows, and
agent skills for the AI Edge Quantizer framework.

## Directory Structure

- [`skills/auto_quant/`](skills/auto_quant/): Agent skill guidelines and
reference documentation for AI Edge Quantizer automatic quantization recipe
